name: campaign_implementation_done
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

outcome.description: Current campaign outcome. Any non-empty string other than 'running' counts as a terminal (done) outcome.

remaining.description: IDs of tasks not yet completed. An empty array counts as done regardless of outcome.

done.description: True when remaining is an empty array, or outcome is a non-empty string other than 'running'.
